reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "default to multizone karpenter deployment #6373 (Reed Schalo)", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Karpenter now uses a multizone deployment by default, so controller pods may be placed differently than before.
consequence.remediation: Check how the Karpenter controller pods are spread across zones after the upgrade, and make sure the cluster has nodes in more than one zone that can run them.

proposed.statement: In Karpenter 1.0.0, the Karpenter controller deployment is spread across multiple zones by default.
